A Service Contract of Omie as callers consume it: the number the user knows, the validity period and the negotiated value, with the dates already parsed. Projected from the listing so no caller has to deal with Omie's dd/MM/yyyy strings or with which key carries what.

OmieContractInfo(long, string?, long, DateOnly?, DateOnly?, decimal?, IReadOnlyDictionary<long, decimal>)

A Service Contract of Omie as callers consume it: the number the user knows, the validity period and the negotiated value, with the dates already parsed. Projected from the listing so no caller has to deal with Omie's dd/MM/yyyy strings or with which key carries what.

public OmieContractInfo(long ContractCode, string? ContractNumber, long ClientCode, DateOnly? ValidFrom, DateOnly? ValidTo, decimal? MonthlyValue, IReadOnlyDictionary<long, decimal> UnitValueByServiceCode)

Parameters

ContractCode long

Omie's internal identifier (nCodCtr).

ContractNumber string

The contract number as the user reads it in Omie (cNumCtr).

ClientCode long

Client the contract belongs to (nCodCli).

ValidFrom DateOnly?

Start of the validity period; null when Omie sent none.

ValidTo DateOnly?

End of the validity period; null on contracts with no end date.

MonthlyValue decimal?

Negotiated monthly value; null when Omie sent none.

UnitValueByServiceCode IReadOnlyDictionary<long, decimal>

Negotiated unit price of each service in the contract, keyed by Omie's service identifier (nCodServico) — the same key the service catalog uses, so a caller holding a service code can ask what this client pays for it. Empty when the contract carries no items.
